==={{header|FreeBASIC}}===
<syntaxhighlight lang="vb">Dim As Uinteger n, num
Print "First 20 Cullen numbers:"

For n = 1 To 20
    num = n * (2^n)+1
    Print num; " ";
Next

Print !"\n\nFirst 20 Woodall numbers:"

For n = 1 To 20
    num = n * (2^n)-1
    Print num; " ";
Next n
Sleep</syntaxhighlight>
